options: A Power BI report connected to Snowflake
A fully loaded raw_customers table in Snowflake
A finished staging model
A scaffolded project folder with dbt_project.yml, a models/ directory, and starter files
questions.explain: dbt init asks a few setup questions and scaffolds the project structure — it doesn't load data or build any models by itself.

questions.q: Why does the real Snowflake connection live in profiles.yml, outside the project folder, instead of inside dbt_project.yml?
options: Because Snowflake blocks connections defined inside a project folder
Because dbt_project.yml cannot contain YAML keys
So credentials are never accidentally committed to version control
Because profiles.yml is required to be inside the models/ folder
questions.explain: Keeping real credentials outside the project, typically in ~/.dbt/profiles.yml, is what lets a shared Git repo stay credential-free while each developer connects with their own identity.

questions.q: What has to match exactly between dbt_project.yml and profiles.yml for the connection to work?
options: The database name and the dbt version number
Nothing needs to match; dbt connects automatically
The profile name — the `profile:` value in dbt_project.yml must equal a top-level key in profiles.yml
The Snowflake account URL and the warehouse name
questions.explain: The `profile:` string in dbt_project.yml must exactly match a top-level key in profiles.yml — that shared name is how dbt links a project to its credentials.

questions.q: What command confirms dbt can actually talk to Snowflake before any model is built?
options: dbt run
dbt test
dbt debug
dbt docs generate
questions.explain: dbt debug checks the connection and reports Connection test: [OK connection ok] on success, or tells you exactly which setting is wrong if it fails.

questions.q: In this lesson's profiles.yml example, which database does the connection point at, and why does that matter?
options: jaffle_shop_capstone — the dbt project's own name
jaffle_shop_raw — the exact database Lesson 3 loaded raw_customers into
dbt_yourname — the personal development schema
analytics — a generic placeholder database
questions.explain: The connection's database field is set to jaffle_shop_raw specifically so dbt can actually see the raw_customers table loaded in Lesson 3.
